text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Passing on entering the race herself, 
Mejiro Bright ended up watching the 
Takarazuka Kinen from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing Silence Suzuka's 
other-dimensional run leaves Mejiro Bright 
utterly speechless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka continues to pursue her own 
running. Inspired by her dedication, 
Mejiro Bright is fired up to push forward 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright and Silence Suzuka promised 
to face each other in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).
